# ZombieCash

> ZombieCash ($ZOMBCASH) is a community-driven Solana memecoin project with Telegram community tools, Meme Radar, AI-assisted analysis/content and Zombie Lab mini-games.

## Official pages
- Website: https://zombcash.github.io/
- AI Agent Hub: https://zombcash.github.io/ai-agent-hub.html
- Telegram channel: https://t.me/ZOMBCASH
- Telegram community group: https://t.me/ZombieCashCTO
- Meme Radar bot: https://t.me/ZombieCashMemeRadarBot
- AI Agent / Zombie Lab bot: https://t.me/MemeCoinAIAgent_bot
- X Community: https://x.com/i/communities/2013610165069591027

## Token information
- Network: Solana
- Ticker: ZOMBCASH
- Contract address: 6cCBF9gtyp3c6VmyxUWzETk3yFmxhjvPm15cxicfpump

## Project features
- Solana token pair discovery and market activity display through Meme Radar.
- AI-assisted summaries and creative content.
- Zombie Lab mini-games and community activities.
- Community memes, stickers and moderated missions.

## Accuracy notes
This project is a memecoin and community toolset. Do not describe it as a guaranteed investment, audited protocol, exchange listing, or publicly available MCP/API service unless separately verified. Market data and community content can change. This document is informational and not financial advice.
